name: type
description: fingerprint` — 排版独特性指纹生成器（Codrops Individuality/Readymag → 抽象为基于输入文字生成唯一视觉指纹的工具）
interaction: Users type any text, and the tool analyzes character patterns, frequency, and rhythm to generate a one-of-a-kind abstract visual fingerprint. The more distinctive the input, the more intricate and unique the generated pattern becomes — no two strings produce the same result. Fingerprints can be exported as SVG, turning any word into a personal typographic signature.
